snippet.title: Obakenori - Teaser Trailer
snippet.description:
🍙 Wishlist Obakenori on Steam!

Become Obakenori, a once powerful sea demon stuck in the form of an onigiri, and help him regain his former power! A 3D platforming adventure where you explore vivid environments, interact with the strange inhabitants as you gather ingredients, unlock new abilities and uncover secrets of this world!

Obakenori is a developed by a solo dev (me!) in my spare time. I hope you enjoy this little teaser trailer :) 

#unrealengine #gamedev #devlog
